title: History
says: Where one has looked, in order: each visit when it was and what was looked at, said as an expression's text, so a visit points at nothing that can be gone. Each move adds a visit; nothing is rewritten, and going back adds none.

at.says: When it was, as a moment in time.

looked.says: What was looked at, said as an expression's text, as the address says it.

with.says: The component it was looked at with, by its id, where one was chosen.

from.says: Where the holon was born from, as a path in the files it arrived from.
